**Checks performed before posting:** confirmed via ledger search that none of the five vendors had an existing entry (no duplicates) and that US 2100 held no accrual for them (nothing to reverse). Every entry is under the USD 10,000 threshold, so no controller approval requests were needed. No exceptions had to be flagged.

**Net effect on US March:** AP up USD 27,395.55; March expense USD 14,395.55; prepaids of USD 8,800 (insurance) and USD 4,200 (event deposit) carried on the balance sheet.

**Housekeeping:** US "AP cutoff review" marked complete. The memo notes two follow-ups — add the Delmar D&O to the prepaid amortization schedule (USD 800/month through Feb 2027) and release the Meridian deposit to Marketing Programs in the June close.
